primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) is an 11-item scale. Individual item scores are summed for a total possible score of 0 (best) to 60 (worst).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Efficacy analyses were based on the Intent-To-Treat (ITT) population, which included all randomized patients who received a dose of study drug and had at least one valid post-baseline efficacy measurement while on study medication. Of the 417 randomized, 392 received at least one dose of study medication and had at least one valid post-baseline efficacy measurement.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline to Week 4 in Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) Total Score
primaryOutcomeMeasures.unitOfMeasure: Change from Baseline in YMRS Total Score
